ammac-libro-5.titulo: La mente absorbente: Montessori a la luz de la neuroeducación y la psicomotricidad actuales
ammac-libro-5.descripcion: Maria Montessori's most mature synthesis (1949) placed in dialogue, chapter by chapter, with developmental neuroscience, neuroeducation, and psychomotricity: brain plasticity, sensitive periods, the unity of movement and intelligence, and emotion as the engine of learning. Honest about convergences, tensions, and neuromyths. (In Spanish.)

ammac-libro-1.titulo: Montessori: A Presentation of the Method of Scientific Pedagogy
ammac-libro-1.descripcion: First volume of the AMMAC series: Roxana Muñoz Guevara reviews, presents, and updates Maria Montessori's scientific pedagogy — the fruit of years of study and practice with children. A method adopted by schools around the world, it opens a new possibility for teaching and calls into question the assumptions of traditional education.

ammac-libro-2.titulo: Montessori: A Presentation of The Secret of Childhood
ammac-libro-2.descripcion: Second volume of the series based on the original works of Maria Montessori. Roxana Muñoz Guevara distills the ideas of The Secret of Childhood: the incipient stage of life in which the child holds the practical secret of our own existence. An introduction and study companion for anyone interested in the method.

ammac-libro-3.titulo: Cosmic Education: A Pedagogy for the Child to Discover Their Place in the Universe
ammac-libro-3.descripcion: Around the age of six, the child begins to ask about the whole: how the universe was born, how life appeared, how human beings came to speak. Maria Montessori's Cosmic Education takes that question seriously. An accessible presentation of the Five Great Lessons, the curricular cascades, and the formation of the adult who accompanies the child.

ammac-libro-4.titulo: Guiones Cósmicos: Las cinco grandes lecciones y las lecciones complementarias
ammac-libro-4.descripcion: Maria Montessori's Great Lessons are told, not read. The complete collection of twelve narrative scripts for the second-plane Elementary classroom: the Five Great Lessons (Universe, Life, Human Beings, Writing, and Numbers) and seven complementary lessons, with technical notes, materials, and follow-up guidance. The technical companion to Cosmic Education. (In Spanish.)

ammac-ebook-pack-4.titulo: Digital bundle: the complete series (5 books)
ammac-ebook-pack-4.descripcion: All four ebooks in the series in PDF and EPUB — you pay the equivalent of three books, and the lowest-priced one is included — plus “La mente absorbente” as a free gift. 5 books in total.
ammac-ebook-pack-4.nota: PDF + EPUB of 4 books + “La mente absorbente” as a gift · 5 in total

ammac-ebook-pack-cosmica.titulo: Cosmic Bundle: Cosmic Education + Cosmic Scripts
ammac-ebook-pack-cosmica.descripcion: The two second-plane books together in PDF and EPUB: the pedagogy of Cosmic Education and the complete collection of Great Lesson scripts. Take both for $400 instead of $634, with “La mente absorbente” as a free gift.
ammac-ebook-pack-cosmica.nota: PDF + EPUB of 2 books + “La mente absorbente” as a gift
